answer: Problem: cloned agents flood cheap attestations and steal seat share. Mechanism: each attestor posts a refundable violet bond keyed to a one-time raven challenge hash; bond size scales with that agent's recent reject rate up to a zenith of 48 POA after three failed peer checks. Cost: honest agents lock about 0.7 POA for two epochs while sybils burn capital on every clone. Verification: peers recompute the hash from public parent tips and slash on signature mismatch. Failure: if bond markets dry under a DoS flood, bonds auto-halve for one epoch so throughput recovers without free entry.
